title: Lock the supported loopback-only exposure path
verify: Independent verification proves the documented executable start uses 127.0.0.1, local smoke remains healthy, no host/LAN/CORS/bearer mode is exposed, and public smoke responses contain no product/auth data.

verify.basis: Independent T3 verification of FT-015-AC-002: fresh rerun of loopback_runtime gate (38 passed), memory_bank_lint (229 files), git diff --check (exit 0); fresh local smoke of the documented launch path bound 127.0.0.1:8000 only (ss LISTEN loopback), /health {'status':'ok'} and /ready {'status':'ready'} both HTTP 200 with no product/auth material; independent source scan found no CORS middleware, no host/bind/cors/bearer settings or env keys, no server host config in bootstrap; runbook documents loopback-only; pre-implementation GREEN claim independently confirmed TRUE (production already conformant, no production change made); no forbidden surface added and no public data broadened.
verify.next_owner: Scheduler: per-task /red-verify TASK-063-T3-FT-015-W1 is required before T3 closure; lifecycle left unchanged (in_progress).

verify.summary: Adversarial probes: only supported launch path is uvicorn --host 127.0.0.1 (no uvicorn.run/config/Makefile/Docker/HOST/PORT/CORS/BEARER keys); live smoke loopback-only, /health /ready product/auth-free; live OPTIONS from foreign origin 405 no CORS header; Authorization fail-closed 403/401; no surface creep (diff = runbook + tests only); LAN not-applicable grounded in canonical disposition; no findings.

evidence_required: FT-015-AC-002 RED: no current executable launch/config surface proves loopback-only binding or the absence of LAN/host/CORS/bearer mode; GREEN: the executable runbook/bootstrap contract binds 127.0.0.1, exposes no LAN/host/CORS/bearer setting, and keeps public smoke product/auth-free; decisive comparison: launch/config scan plus local smoke results; artifact: runtime-policy transcript under .tasks/TASK-063-T3-FT-015-W1/. Pre-implementation GREEN is preserved without unnecessary production change.
purpose: Make the accepted absence of optional LAN mode an executable security result while retaining the one supported loopback runtime.
success_outcome: The supported local launch is unambiguously loopback-only, health/readiness work locally, and the current product exposes no configurable LAN/CORS/bearer access mode; future LAN work must return to design.
anti_goals: Do not implement LAN, host override, CORS middleware/config, bearer transport, TLS, certificate handling, or remote smoke.
Do not broaden public health/readiness data.
constraints: Treat LAN as not applicable for FT-015, not as an untested hidden mode.
Use local deterministic smoke only; no external interface/network authorization is granted.
invariants: Every supported first-demo backend launch binds loopback.
Optional LAN controls cannot be claimed until an explicit implementation/design task exists.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-002: source/config/runbook plus local smoke prove loopback-only support and absence of LAN mode.

forbidden_scope: LAN/CORS/TLS/bearer implementation, remote network probing, frontend, server sync, or provider egress.
stop_conditions: Current production code already exposes a non-loopback mode requiring a product/security decision.
Proof would require probing another machine or changing host firewall/network state.
